name: Flooding Disrupts Access to St. Jude Memorial Hospital

location.epicenter: Intersection of Metropolitan Parkway & River Road
location.facility_name: St. Jude Memorial Hospital (Level 1 Trauma Center)

initial_incident_report.text: Flash flooding has submerged Metropolitan Parkway under at least 2.5 feet of fast water. Ambulances cannot enter the emergency bay driveway.
